display_name: 冻结CRIT三种子：辅助难度排序与实际采样收益源域诊断
description: 基于源日志选择熵近均匀的证据，区分辅助难度排序失效与采样尺度失配；L/V全量8候选，零参数更新，不读目标结果
authorization: 持续84%目标的源域机制研究；依据当前源日志诊断，不使用目标分数调参；不干预健康训练

code.commit: resolved from immutable Git release at launch

data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: IQ/RX/day/opaque UID;15domain round-robin, within-domain private permutation before reuse; no TX grouping or same-sig cross-RX pairing

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1 unchanged; U_s TX truth never visible
data.diagnostic_access: L6300 and V27000 IQ/TX/RX/day/opaque IDs. V y enters diagnostic metrics only; V candidate bank lookup is TX-blind. No U opened; no target.

permissions.claim_scope: frozen source auxiliary predictive ranking and actual sampling effectiveness; V is seen-RX holdout

checkpoint.initialization: corresponding CRIT final40 and auxiliary_state from fixed15row experiment, both frozen; original matchedE200 ancestry checked

physical.action_targets: four actual applied tap components / scale
physical.repetition_target: leave-cycle relative template residual24 + learned diagonal uncertainty
physical.known_linear_scope: small circular digital filter; interior-only diagnostic required

rx_action.U_fit: all six L TX, other two days; U TX never read

rx_action.action_selection: eight candidates: four other sourceRX times two fixed scales; no identity class prediction in bank lookup

notes: No target loader/prediction/score access, no optimizer or fit during diagnostic.
L uses labeled training bank; V uses TX-blind U bank. Differences combine held-out packets and bank role, not a pure L/V causal effect.
V only scores frozen outputs, never updates banks/model/critic. Parent already saw all five sourceRX.

No candidate or hyperparameter selection in this diagnostic; report every fixed row and stratum.
